title: Commission Tier/Flat — the copied band is not recorded in History (NM-4216 regression)
requirementSource: NM-4216: History must show both records of a copy — the removed old band (Remove) and the new copied band (Copy)
stepsToReproduce: Open Setup → Commissions → Tier/Flat for office 1101 (/navigator/locations/1101/commissions/tiers) on e2e and click Search.
Add a band on ZSub Rental Specialty (0 – 99,999,901) and one on ZSub Contractor Specialty Labor (5 – 99,999,901); Save.
Copy → Copy Within Location: source ZSub Rental Specialty, tick ZSub Contractor Specialty Labor, Apply (confirm the overwrite).
Open the Commission Tier/Flat History tab.
expectedBehavior: A Copy entry for the new 0 – 99,999,901 band on ZSub Contractor Specialty Labor.
actualBehavior: Only the Remove of the old band is listed; there is no Copy (or Add) entry for the copied band, although the copy itself takes effect (TC-COM-TF-078 lists it after a search).

verificationLog.finding: History of the copy at 08:45 (isolated rerun) lists no entry for the copied band.
